headline: Anthropic prices its stock market listing at $83 a share, above its target range, reports say
summary: Anthropic, the AI company that makes Claude, priced its initial public offering at $83 a share on Wednesday 18 November, above its $70 to $78 range, according to a person familiar with the matter cited by Reuters. The shares are due to start trading on Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT.
why: Reuters calls it one of the largest stock market listings on record and the first by a major developer of advanced AI models. It is a test of how much investors will pay for AI after weeks of swings in tech stocks.

event.t: Reuters, CNBC and The Wall Street Journal reported the price, citing people familiar with the matter. Anthropic had planned to sell about 825 million shares.
Anthropic set the $70 to $78 range in a filing on 10 November.

effects.label: AI stocks
effects.t: Investors watched the listing after days of swings in AI shares.
